SELECTED PROJECTS
=================

IAAC COMMERCE / SAELUNE ACTIVE
A reusable ecommerce platform with React/TypeScript storefront and admin apps, a .NET 10 serverless API and AWS CDK infrastructure.

Work includes variant-based catalog browsing, profiles, carts, favourites and product administration. Checkout uses atomic stock reservations and idempotency protections, with Peach Payments hosted checkout and Bob Go delivery integration.

Live: https://dnmpjdbyl3ja5.cloudfront.net/

PRIMARY ONBOARDING
A multi-tenant business operations platform for South African freelancers and small businesses. It brings customers, quotes, service agreements, invoices, payment records, receipts, expenses and reporting into one workflow.

The static React/Next.js frontend is served through S3 and CloudFront. An ASP.NET Core API runs on Lambda behind API Gateway, with tenant- and branch-scoped DynamoDB access patterns. Cognito, SES, SQS and EventBridge Scheduler support authentication and email automation.

Live: https://d3223h59o0v7yn.cloudfront.net/

SERVERLESS BLOG & CUSTOM CMS
A reusable publication platform with article drafting, editorial approval, scheduling, publishing, rich-text/Markdown authoring, media uploads and role-based access.

The public site supports categories, search, SEO metadata, newsletters, branding and contact forms. CDK provisions separate AWS resources for client deployments.

Live: https://d2d5b0j6iun0gv.cloudfront.net/

PGLN.AUTH
A reusable .NET 10 authentication platform using ASP.NET Core, EF Core and PostgreSQL. Features include email verification, JWT access tokens, refresh-token rotation with replay detection, password recovery, sessions and trusted devices.

Repository: https://github.com/NuGetPackagesPGLN/PGLN.JwtAuth
